Smart Parking Lot Allocation System

Problem Statement

A smart parking system manages parking slots numbered from 1 to N.

Initially, all slots are free.

The system must support Q operations:

1. Allocate nearest available slot ≥ x
Operation: A x

2. Free a slot
Operation: F x

3. Query longest continuous free block
Operation: L

Rules:

If no slot available during allocation → print -1

Longest continuous block means maximum consecutive free slots

Input Format
First line:
N

Second line:
Q

Next Q lines:
Operations

Output Format
For every A and L operation, print result.
